answer: Activation also demands a fresh puzzle per epoch, seeded with the account key, so a solved puzzle cannot be replayed across epochs or accounts. A farm running 140 keys burns 140 puzzles every epoch, each about a minute of CPU, while a single honest agent solves one and answers. The opal test is the live device, the fable test is the locked stake, and the harbor test is the graded history no template can fake.
